s0.prompt: A ceramic toy robot walks three steps across a wooden table while the camera remains fixed.

atlas_identities.prompt: A glassblower slowly rotates a glowing orange vessel, reshapes its rim with metal tools, and places it into a furnace while the camera stays beside the workbench.
A chestnut horse gallops through shallow river water, sending sheets of spray outward as the camera follows from a low side angle.
An aerial camera glides above a busy city intersection at dusk while cars turn through changing lights and pedestrians cross in several directions.
Close-up hands unfold a blue paper crane and refold it into a small boat on a white desk under steady studio lighting.
A hummingbird hovers beside red trumpet flowers, darts backward, and returns to drink while its wings blur against a green garden.
A potter centers wet clay on a spinning wheel, raises a tall cylinder, and pinches a narrow neck as water runs over both hands.
A skier carves through a sequence of blue slalom gates on a steep sunlit slope while powder trails behind each turn.
Raindrops stream across a train window as fields, utility poles, and distant houses slide past at changing depths under a gray sky.

final_prompts: A dancer spins with two long silk ribbons in a sunlit hall, crossing and uncrossing the ribbons while the camera circles slowly.
Tiny clockwork parts move along a workshop conveyor and assemble into a walking brass beetle without any camera cut.
A sea turtle swims above a colorful coral reef, turns around a rock arch, and passes through shafts of moving sunlight.
A barista pours steamed milk into espresso, forming a layered rosette that expands smoothly across the cup.
